title: Bigfoot researcher Ronny LeBlanc to visit Norwich library
excerpt: Discovery Channel researcher Ronny LeBlanc will discuss Bigfoot history and evidence at the Otis Library in Norwich.
content:
Oct. 9, 2026, 4:46 a.m. ET

People curious about Bigfoot and other unexplained phenomena can hear from television personality and researcher Ronny LeBlanc during a program at Otis Library in Norwich from 5:30 to 6:30 p.m. Oct. 19, according to a community announcement.

The free presentation, titled "What is Bigfoot?," will take place in the library's Community Room and will examine the history, legends and reported encounters connected to the creature also known as Sasquatch.

LeBlanc is featured on Discovery Channel's "Expedition Bigfoot" and Travel Channel's "Paranormal Caught on Camera." The author and investigator is expected to discuss Native American traditions, eyewitness reports and decades of research tied to Bigfoot sightings.

Drawing on his investigations across New England and four seasons spent filming "Expedition Bigfoot," LeBlanc will share experiences from the field and describe evidence often cited by Bigfoot researchers.

The program also will explore reports of unusual activity that some witnesses have associated with Bigfoot encounters, including mysterious lights, orbs, UFOs and other unexplained phenomena, according to the announcement.

Exploring a long-running mystery

Organizers say the event is intended for believers, skeptics and those who are simply interested in one of North America's most enduring mysteries.

Attendees will have an opportunity to hear LeBlanc's perspective on reported sightings and the evidence surrounding Sasquatch while considering competing explanations for the phenomenon.

Registration information

Registration is required for the event. More information and registration details are available through otislibrarynorwich.org or by calling 860-889-2365, ext. 128.

Otis Library is located at 261 Main St. in Norwich. People seeking accommodations may contact Kari at kwall@otislibrarynorwich.org.
